successors.name: Maratha Empire
successors.text: the Poona lands with the Javali valley near Mahabaleshwar, the Satara side and Kalyan in the Konkan

ledger.x: 1647: Shivaji, about 16, takes Torna Fort and the Pune lands begin to pass to him.
1656: Shivaji kills Chandrarao More and seizes the Javali valley; Kalyan in the Konkan also held.
Territory passes to the Maratha Empire, crowned 1674.
Continues as the Maratha Empire from 1674.

certainty.note: Page gives no boundaries; outlines are polygons around named places.
